findings.description: The animation loop renders a cached drawState.travel and never rereads anchor geometry; getBoundingClientRect occurs only in update, invoked by scroll/measurement/media events. A consumer-owned animated or independently moving anchor can move without any of those events, leaving the isotipo and confinement behind and potentially overlapping text. The approved plan explicitly requires remeasurement while the visible engine runs (implementation-plan.md:156). Existing tests pass but do not establish this case.

Composite multiplies sampled RGBA by the feather mask before sRGB conversion. Semitransparent render-target pixels are susceptible to premultiplied-alpha/color-space mismatch; source tests inspect shader text rather than actual GPU pixels. Do not treat pixel correctness as verified without a controlled real-GL alpha/color comparison.

Recorded travel follow-up lists identities, opacities and fallback states, not sampled isotipo pixel positions or colors; it cannot prove continuous travel or confinement. Two cold-load 404s remain unexplained in the record.

overall_verdict: FAIL — d7fa149 restores recovery for observed layout-box size changes, but the previously reported transform-to-zero recovery case remains: ResizeObserver does not notify for CSS transforms. The detailed runtime trace differential also remains unverified.

code.evidence: useHomeTemplate.ts:450-464 and :568-581 re-resolve both endpoints and recompute travel on each normal-motion frame. The frame guard at :583-585 keeps one loop, cleanup cancels it, and reduced motion stops rather than schedules at :558-565. Invalid travel restores fallbacks and opacity zero at :451-456. However, after a zero-area frame, the loop stops; anchor size recovery alone is not observed because the ResizeObserver watches document.body (:367-369), not anchors. If an anchor scales to zero and back without a scroll, resize, load, body resize or other update, the 3D and fallback remain stuck until an unrelated event. This is a regression introduced by the new frame-time invalidation.

observer_and_recovery.evidence: useHomeTemplate.ts:124-135 guards observe/unobserve, :378-388 observes existing registrations and body, :414-415 disconnects, and :351-358 coalesces updates. Normal-motion and reduced-motion paint paths require successful render before marking fallback painted (:473-492, :579-584). Frame guards and cleanup prevent duplicate loops by inspection. Layout-size changes that generate ResizeObserver entries recover. However ResizeObserver observes layout box dimensions, not CSS transforms: transform scale(0) makes getBoundingClientRect zero and stops the 3D loop, while changing scale back without a layout resize produces no notification, so the previously reported transform-to-zero witness remains stuck. The observer is optional, so recovery also depends on another event when unavailable.

findings.description: An anchor or ancestor animated with CSS transform scale(0) yields a zero visual bounding box, stopping the loop. Returning to a nonzero scale does not resize the layout box and does not generate a ResizeObserver notification. With no other subscribed event the 3D remains suppressed. The prior transform-to-zero recovery finding is therefore not fully resolved.
